private_lines.Frida: You work as a nurse on shifts at a hospital in Oslo and walk dogs around the park when you are off, which helps with money. You live alone in a small apartment on the east side of the city.
private_lines.Jon: You run a small carpentry workshop in Oslo and walk dogs around the park before and after your work. You live alone in a house with a workshop in the garage.
private_lines.Thomas: You study at the University of Oslo and walk dogs at the park for pocket money between lectures and study sessions. You share a flat in Oslo with other students who are not part of this chat.
